game.pausedZoom: The view was zoomed, so the map is on hold. Pinch back to normal, then resume.
game.moverTutorialBody: Orange obstacles patrol a track. Balls bounce off them; a fence that touches one costs a life.
game.breakTutorialBody: Glass breaks on one touch, amber needs a few. Steer balls in; you cannot fence against them.
game.circuitTutorialBody: Draw a fence past a teal node to wake its sleeping ball, then trap it. Sleepers hold their space shut until woken.
game.boxIntroBody: Balls go in through the membrane and never come out. Fill the box; until it is full its floor stays off the board.
game.launcherIntroBody:
Every ball is in the barrel. Pull the band and release: direction aims, length sets speed.

That speed never fades and multiplies the map's pay. No fences until the barrel empties; seal a ball inside first and you lose a life.
game.launcherTutorialBody: The balls sit in the barrel until you pull the band and let go. Fire harder for a faster map that pays more.
game.boxTutorialBody: Balls go in through the membrane and never come out. Fill the box; until it is full its floor stays off the board.
game.chargeTutorialBody: Draw a fence past a fuse to arm it. It blows its slab open, but also frees nearby balls and breaks your fences in range.
game.streamTutorialBody: Draw a fence ALONG the violet seam, not across it, to harvest overtime. More coverage pays more but loosens your trap.
game.creepTutorialBody: Balls speed up the longer you take, up to a cap. Finish fast and you never feel it. The red gauge shows the surge.
game.pickupTutorialBody: Lock a ball in a pocket that also holds a power-up to claim it. Wait too long and it fades.
game.gravityWellTutorialBody:
A gravity well bends any ball inside it toward the arrow, then lets go. Speed never changes. Use it to steer a ball into a pocket you already fenced.

A frozen ball ignores gravity. Some wells start dormant and switch on once enough of the board is cleared.
game.topBarTutorialBody: Your level, lives and objectives sit up top. Tap it, or Specs, for your full run sheet.
game.bottomBarTutorialBody: Tap Specs any time for every stat that shapes your run, explained plainly.
game.fenceSlotsTutorialBody: The row under the board picks which fence your next cut draws. Slot 1 is standard and never runs out; the others hold specials you unlock. Tap a slot and every cut is that type until you pick another. Hold a slot to read it.
game.timeLimitTutorialBody: Every map now has a time limit. Beat the clock or the run ends, lives or not. Finish early for bonus overtime.

lockInfo.title: Superior Lock
lockInfo.normalBody: Seal a ball in its own pocket to lock it. It pays its lock value; tougher balls pay more.
lockInfo.superiorBody: Seal a ball in a pocket well under half the usual size. Pays double, earns a gold star.

lockExplainer.line: Fence a ball into a tight pocket to lock it for extra points.

interactiveTutorial.dragInstruction: Drag inside the area to grow a slicing wall. Don't let a ball hit it while it grows!

levelComplete.title: Level Complete!

level.title: Level
level.body: The map you cleared. Later maps pay more and add new balls and mechanics.
level.tip: Stay alive to reach deeper, richer maps. Upgrades last the whole run.

remaining.title: Remaining Space
remaining.body: Board still open when you won. Clear a map by fencing space until you are under its target.
remaining.tip: Clearing extra feeds the Space Bonus; finishing fast pays Ship Early.

fencesUsed.title: Fences vs Par
fencesUsed.body: Fences used against par. Under par pays full base; each fence over scales it down (x0.75, x0.6, x0.4). 3 or more over also kills the Space Bonus.
fencesUsed.tip: Favor fewer, bigger cuts. Finishing even one fence under par adds a bonus hour.

spaceBonus.title: Space Bonus
spaceBonus.body: Extra space removed beyond the target: +1h at 10%, +2h at 30%, +3h at 55%. Off if you finish 3 or more fences over par.
spaceBonus.tip: Before your winning cut, squeeze out a little more of the board. Near-total clears pay the top rung.

baseOvertime.title: Base Overtime
baseOvertime.body: The map's flat payout, scaled by fence performance. The bonuses are where the real money is.
baseOvertime.tip: Stay at or under par to keep the full base, then stack bonuses on top of it.

threadLocks.title: Thread Locks
threadLocks.body: Seal a ball in its own pocket to lock it. Each pays its lock value; tougher balls pay more. Several in one cut multiply the payout (2 = double, 3 = triple). An extra-tight pocket makes it a Superior Lock, worth double.
threadLocks.tip: Lock a green money ball early: it triples every later lock. Then herd balls together and close one cut around them.

superiorLocks.title: Superior Locks
superiorLocks.body: A Superior Lock is a pocket well under half the size that would normally lock. It pays double, and every other multiplier stacks on top.
superiorLocks.tip: Cut as close to the ball as you dare. Roomy pockets pay standard; the tight cage is where the money is.

zoneLocks.title: Zone Locks
zoneLocks.body: Coloured var, let and const boxes pay 1.5x, 2x, 3x on any ball locked inside. It stacks with everything, so a Superior lock in a const box is the biggest payout in the game. Already counted in your lock income above.
zoneLocks.tip: The zone lights up when a lock counts. Dark means the pocket missed the box: settle the ball inside the border, not near it.

multiLocks.title: Multi-Lock
multiLocks.body: Several balls in one cut multiply that cut's lock income: two pays double, three triple, and every other multiplier stacks. Only the extra hours over locking them one by one show here.
multiLocks.tip: Do not seal a pocket the moment it is safe. Let a second ball in: one cut around two beats two cuts around one.

bouncerHours.title: Bumper Hours
bouncerHours.body: Each bumper holds a small bank of overtime and pays 1h per hit until it runs dry. Green ones also brake the ball 5%; red ones are spent and kick it faster instead. Paid above the map cap.
bouncerHours.tip: The reward for not rushing: every brake is an hour you did not bank. Drain a cluster and it starts throwing your balls around.

breakBonus.title: Demolition Bonus
breakBonus.body: Overtime from smashing blocks. Glass goes on one touch, amber takes a few, and whatever rests on top falls with it.
breakBonus.tip: Steer balls into them with your cuts. The black ball breaks amber in half the hits.

shipEarly.title: Ship Early
shipEarly.body: A tempo bonus for winning fast: +1h within 60s, +2h within 40s, +3h within 25s. Only active play counts.
shipEarly.tip: Open with big, confident cuts. Speed and precision are separate bonuses; chase both.

pushBonus.title: Push Bonus
pushBonus.body: The push-your-luck reward. After hitting the target, keep cutting instead of banking; every extra slice pays.
pushBonus.tip: Pushing is free money: if you fail mid-push you only lose the extra bonus, never your banked score.

pickupBonus.title: Power-Up Bonus
pickupBonus.body: Overtime from power-up tokens sealed in with a lock. A token only pays if a ball locks in its pocket; unclaimed ones expire.
pickupBonus.tip: Herd a ball toward the token before sealing. Token overtime pays after the cap, so it always counts.

overtime.name: Overtime +{{value}}h:
overtime.desc: paid on top of the map's cap.

fork.name: Ball split:
fork.desc: split a ball into more lock income.

freeShopItem.name: Free store item:
freeShopItem.desc: the cheapest offer in your next open store is free.

rainbowConvert.name: Rainbow ball:
rainbowConvert.desc: turned a ball into a high-value rainbow ball.

overtimePercent.name: Overtime +{{value}}%:
overtimePercent.desc: paid a share of your banked overtime, on top of the cap.

newHighscore.title: New Highscore
newHighscore.body: You beat this map's record, so the payout is x1.25. Applied after the cap, so it always pays extra.
newHighscore.tip: Records are kept per map. A strong upgrade build can beat your old scores map after map.

totalBonus.title: Total Bonus
totalBonus.body: All this level's bonuses added together: par, space, locks, demolition, tempo and push.
totalBonus.tip: Bonuses share a cap of twice the base, so spreading across several beats maxing one.

overtimeEarned.title: Overtime Earned
overtimeEarned.body: The level's total: scaled base plus all bonuses, capped at twice the base. A highscore multiplies past the cap. The number after the slash is the most this map could have paid.
overtimeEarned.tip: Hitting the cap often? Chase the highscore multiplier: it applies after the cap.

totalOvertime.title: Total Overtime
totalOvertime.body: Your run's overtime so far. Spend it in the shop between levels; what is left banks when the run ends.
totalOvertime.tip: Spending buys power and charges Budget Cycle; a fat bank feeds Runway and War Chest. Your build decides.

axis_delivery.title: Delivery
axis_delivery.body: The share of the map's balls you sealed. The baseline: it gates the other lanes, so a clear that locks nothing earns the base and no more.
axis_delivery.tip: Lock every ball. A loose ball costs its share of Delivery AND of Tempo, Thrift and Greed.

axis_craft.title: Craft
axis_craft.body: How good the locks were, not how many. Full lane: every ball in a superior pocket. Zones, multi-locks, money balls and frozen locks reach it by other routes.
axis_craft.tip: Tight pockets cost time and fences: Craft is bought with Tempo and Thrift. Pick a pair and commit.

axis_tempo.title: Tempo
axis_tempo.body: How fast you first met the win condition, in active seconds. Windows scale with the ball count; pauses do not count.
axis_tempo.tip: Speed is bought by leaving pockets loose. Want Craft instead? Ignore the clock; it is worth about the same.

axis_thrift.title: Thrift
axis_thrift.body: Finishing under par, as a fraction of par, so a par-4 and a par-10 map are equally winnable.
axis_thrift.tip: Coarse cuts finish under par but leave loose pockets: Thrift fights Craft. Pair it with Tempo.

axis_greed.title: Greed
axis_greed.body: Board you were allowed to leave but took anyway, plus push-your-luck hours. Off at three fences over par.
axis_greed.tip: Extra clearing costs fences and time. Greed pairs with Craft and fights Thrift.

axis_engagement.title: Engagement
axis_engagement.body: The share of the map's features you actually used: breakables smashed, zones locked in, terminals lit, seams harvested, boxes filled. If the map put it there, using it is part of finishing. Maps with none hide this lane.
axis_engagement.tip: Each feature family counts the same, so the one thing on the board is the whole lane. Using them costs time and fences, against Tempo and Thrift.

winBonus.title: Win bonus
winBonus.body: Some maps ask more than a clear: a ball in a zone, a tight pocket, a named ball. When those conditions carry a premium, meeting them pays that percent on top.
winBonus.tip: The premium is set per condition, so it is the same for every route. It scales what you earned, so playing a hard map well pays most.

capBonus.title: Comp Time
capBonus.body: Stock Options and Comp Time raise the ceiling on what a map can pay rather than paying hours themselves. They only matter on a map that reaches its cap.
capBonus.tip: Worth most on maps you already clear well. Far from the ceiling, a cap raise is dead weight.

qualifiedOvertime.title: Qualified Overtime
qualifiedOvertime.body: Paid for sealing several balls in ONE cut. Delivery and Craft fill up before a four-ball pass is felt, so this pays above the ceiling where it cannot be swallowed.
qualifiedOvertime.tip: Herd balls into one pocket and close it with one fence. Two pays; four pays far more.

ballTypes.title: Ball Types
ballTypes.intro: A ball's colour tells you what it does. New colours unlock as you climb.
ballTypes.notEncounteredYet: Not encountered yet. Lock it for more info.

bugs.title: Bugs
bugs.intro: Some shards on a board hold a bug, and you can see it glowing inside before you break anything. Smash that shard and the bug comes out, flying. Run a ball over it to squash it, and whatever it holds lands on that ball. Every one of them costs you something, so read it before you break the shard. You can also tap a loose bug yourself to kill it: that pays nothing, and it is how you refuse one you do not want.
bugs.danger: Dangerous. This one can cost you the map, so tap it to kill it rather than letting a ball reach it.

swipeToCut.title: Swipe to Cut
swipeToCut.description: Swipe or drag to create a slicing wall. Horizontal or vertical based on your swipe direction.

removeEmptySpace.title: Remove Empty Space
removeEmptySpace.description: When the wall completes, the side WITHOUT the ball is removed and becomes darkness.

avoidTheBall.title: Avoid the Ball
avoidTheBall.description: Don't let the ball hit the wall while it's still growing - instant game over!

winCondition.title: Win Condition
winCondition.description: Shrink the arena below the target size to win. Trap a ball in a small enough pocket and it locks for a bonus!

breakObstacles.title: Breaking Obstacles
breakObstacles.description: Glass bricks go on one touch, amber blocks take a few; stacks fall when their support breaks. Breaking is extra, shrinking the board still wins. You cannot fence against either.

fenceTypes.title: Fence Types
fenceTypes.description: The five slots under the board choose your next fence. Slot 1 is standard and never spent; the other four fill with specials from upgrades. Every special builds slower than standard. Tap to select, hold for details.

lives.title: Lives
lives.description: Each run starts with a set number of lives. A ball hitting your growing fence costs one. Out of lives, the run ends.

checkpoints.title: Checkpoints
checkpoints.description: Every 5 levels is a checkpoint. A new run restarts from the highest one you reached.

headStartCertificates.title: Head Start Certificates

capstoneDraft.title: Promotion
capstoneDraft.subtitle: Your review went well. Pick one permanent perk for the rest of this run.
capstoneDraft.exclusiveHint: One pick only. The other two are gone for good.
capstoneDraft.scopeNote: Applies for the rest of the run, including ascension.
capstoneDraft.holdHint: Hold a perk for the full briefing.

continue.title: Continue?
continue.body_one: Spend 1 Continue to retry this level with your overtime and upgrades intact. {{count}} left.
continue.body_other: Spend 1 Continue to retry this level with your overtime and upgrades intact. {{count}} left.

welcome.certLockedBody: Certificates are permanent bonuses earned by mastering upgrade families across runs. Reach a family's top tier, or earn your first certificate by playing, and this store opens. Then spend Certificate Hours to level them up.
welcome.dailyIntroBody: Everyone gets the same run each day from one shared seed. Your result goes on the daily leaderboard, and playing builds a streak. Starts at level 1.

loadouts.title: Loadouts
loadouts.unlockRequirement_one: Win with {{count}} more unique loadout to unlock.
loadouts.unlockRequirement_other: Win with {{count}} more unique loadouts to unlock.
loadouts.unlockedModalBody: First run won! Every run now starts with a loadout: a curse paired with a blessing. Win with different loadouts to unlock more.

achievements.name: Achievements
achievements.body: Level 5 cleared! Achievements now track your milestones. Check them from the main menu.

certificates.name: Certificates
certificates.body: First certificate hour banked! Spend hours in the Certificate store on permanent upgrades. More bank as you clear levels.

loadouts.name: Loadouts
loadouts.body: You beat the game! Every run now starts with a loadout draft: a curse paired with a blessing. Win with different loadouts to unlock more.

panicShockwave.name: Panic Button
panicShockwave.body: First boss beaten! Every map now starts with a free Shockwave: fire it to blast the balls apart when they slow down. Chests can grant more.

hallOfFame.title: Performance Review
hallOfFame.emptyLadder: No runs banked yet. Finish a run and it lands here.

certificateEffects.showHighscoreProgress: Adds the map highscore bar to the HUD
certificateEffects.storeLockReliefOne: The store never asks for more than one lock
certificateEffects.storeLockReliefFull: The store never asks for locks at all
certificateEffects.grantsFenceType: Adds the {{fence}} fence to every run.

boardInfo.hint: Hold anything on the board to see what it is.

bugShard.title: Bug in the wall
bugShard.body: Break this shard and the bug flies out. Then run a ball over it to squash it, and whatever it holds lands on that ball.
bugShard.danger: Dangerous. This one can cost you the map.

pickup.title: Power-up token
pickup.body: Lock a ball in a pocket that holds this to claim it. Captured without a lock, it is wasted.

chestLoot.title: Loot
chestLoot.body: Dropped by a smashed chest, showing what you won. It is already yours.

dormantBall.title: Sleeping ball
dormantBall.body: Not in play yet; fences pass through it. Run a fence through its terminal to wake it. It cannot be locked asleep.

ball.title: Ball
ball.body: Fence it into a small sealed pocket to lock it. Locks are where the money is.

terminal.title: Circuit terminal
terminal.body: Draw a fence through it to light it. Complete the circuit and the ball it is wired to wakes up.

chest.title: Treasure chest
chest.body: Smash it with a ball for loot. Every smash also raises this map payout.

objective.title: Objective crate
objective.body: This map asks you to break it. Send a ball into it.

breakable.title: Breakable block
breakable.body: Takes a few hits to shatter and cracks as it weakens. Breaking it reopens the space under it.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.body: Bounces balls off at hard angles, so their path is hard to read. The black ball can smash it.

mover.title: Moving block
mover.body: Slides along its track, so a gap here is only temporary. Time your fence around it.

phasing.title: Phasing block
phasing.body: Fades in and out. Solid when visible, passable when not. A fence drawn through it while it is out is cut when it returns.

deformable.title: Padded block
deformable.body: Never breaks. Every hit dents it and takes 3% off the ball, so it brakes anything that got too fast. The dents stay.

obstacle.title: Obstacle
obstacle.body: Solid. Balls bounce off it and fences stop against it: a good anchor for a pocket.

area.title: Marked zone
area.body: Lock a ball inside this zone for a multiplier. On some maps it is the only way to win.

gameMessages.breakableAnchor: A fence cannot anchor on a breakable. Smash it first, or cut to solid wall.
gameMessages.fenceLimit: You are growing as many fences as you can. Wait for one to finish, or upgrade.
gameMessages.capturedStart: Start your fence in open space. That ground has already been captured.
gameMessages.wallInTheWay: A fence is already anchored there. Start from open space a little further along.
gameMessages.launcherLoaded: The launcher is still firing. You cannot fence until every ball has left it.
gameMessages.lifeLostBall: A ball cut through your fence. Life lost.
gameMessages.lifeLostMover: A moving block cut through your fence. Life lost.
gameMessages.cutWouldTrapBall: That cut would have sealed a ball away with no way out, so it did not land. Leave it a route.
gameMessages.cutWouldBurySlabs: That cut would have put what you still need to break out of reach, so it did not land.
gameMessages.cutWouldBuryArea: That cut would have left no ball that can still get into the zone, so it did not land.
gameMessages.partnersTurn: It's your partner's turn. Watch their fence, yours is next.
gameMessages.oneFenceATurn: One fence a turn. Your partner is up once this one is built.

mapFailure.title: Map failed
mapFailure.areaUnreachable: The zone can no longer be reached
mapFailure.launcherPrematureLock: You sealed a ball in the launcher before it was empty
mapFailure.runOver: No lives left. The run ends here.
mapFailure.tapToFinish: Tap to see how the run went
mapFailure.needSpace: Clear down to {{target}}% remaining (you were at {{current}}%)
mapFailure.needArea: Lock {{target}} balls in the zone (you had {{current}})
mapFailure.lockedOut: Your last ball is locked, so nothing on the board can change now
mapFailure.ballHitFence: A ball cut through your fence
mapFailure.moverHitFence: A moving block cut through your fence
mapFailure.needHarvested: Harvest {{target}} stretches of the stream (you had {{current}})
mapFailure.objectiveBuried: You fenced off a breakable you still had to smash
mapFailure.requirementUnreachable: You fenced off something this map still needs
mapFailure.needSplitLocks: Lock {{each}} on each side of the board (you covered {{current}} of {{target}} sides)

launcher.pullToLaunch: Pull back and release to launch

rubberBand.tutorial: Press where the balls should go, pull back through them, then let go.

fenceTypes.buildsSlower: Builds {{percent}}% slower than a standard fence. That is what it costs.
fenceTypes.buildsFaster: Builds {{percent}}% faster than a standard fence.
fenceTypes.staysSelected: Tap a slot to select it. It stays selected until you change it, and never runs out.

music.title: Jukebox
music.subtitle: Everything the game plays, and who wrote it.

pair.title: 2 Player
pair.intro: One board, two phones, side by side. Show the code and let the other player scan it with their camera.
pair.showCodeHint: Your partner scans it and joins
pair.scanMe: Scan this with the other phone's camera, or send them the link.
pair.failed: Could not reach the other phone.
pair.slowHint: Taking a while. Both phones need internet. On the same Wi-Fi they link up directly, anywhere else through our server.
pair.versionMismatch: One phone is running an older build. Update it and try again.
pair.lostSync: The two boards drifted apart. Restarting this map.
pair.savedRun: You have a run in progress, on map {{level}}.
pair.nearbyHint: Both phones tap this. No code, no Wi-Fi needed.
pair.confirmToken: Both phones should show {{token}}. Tap to join.
pair.needPermission: Dev/End needs one more permission to find nearby phones.
pair.needLocation: Android 11 and below need location switched on to find nearby phones. Dev/End never uses your location for anything else.
pair.sameDevice: Both phones report the same device id, so neither can be told apart. Reinstall one, or pair with the code instead.

host.pushing: {{name}} is deciding whether to push on.
host.continuing: {{name}} is deciding whether to spend a continue.

pair.mismatchTitle: You are not playing the same game.
pair.mismatchBody: One of you has upgrades or certificates the other does not, so the two boards would behave differently. Play a run you both have, or catch up first.
pair.viaRelay: Linked through our server, since this network keeps phones apart.

nap.waking: The server was napping. Waking it up, give it a few seconds.
nap.justWoke: Server just woke up. Still yawning, but ready.
nap.unreachable: The server is not answering. Is this phone online?
nap.whyNap: Our server lives on a tiny cloud plan that naps after 30 minutes of nobody playing. The first knock wakes it, and it needs about 10 seconds to find its slippers.
nap.whyMatters: It matters for 2 Player: the server passes the pairing code between phones, and on cafe, hotel or office Wi-Fi it carries the whole game, because those networks keep phones from talking to each other.

tip.checking: Hang on, it usually answers in a blink.
tip.waking: Nothing to do but wait. Your knock is what is waking it, so it will be up in a moment.
tip.awake: All good. It stays awake as long as someone is playing.
tip.justWoke: Your knock woke it. It is fully up now, so go ahead and pair.
tip.unreachable: Check this phone has internet. If it does, the server may be down for a moment: try again in a minute.

pair.shareText: Join my Dev/End game. Open this on your phone:
pair.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link below and copy it yourself.
